```{r}
# ### install version of highcharter that is compatible with our accessibility requirements

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(csgjcr)
library(highcharter)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(reactable)

source("R/utils.R")
```

```{r}
# Assign colors
darkorange  <- "#7B3014"
orange      <- "#D25E2D"
lightorange <- "#EDB799"
white       <- "#FFFFFF"
lightblue   <- "#9ed4ef"
regblue     <- "#007392"
darkblue    <- "#00475d"

### choose blues from csgjcr for now
blue1 <- "#d4e9f8"
blue2 <- "#9ed4ef"
blue4 <- "#007392"
blue5 <- "#00475d"

axis_expansion_mult <- 0.5

```

```{r}
### import and prep hex map geo
hex <- sf::read_sf("us_states_hexgrid.geojson") |>
  select(state_abb = iso3166_2)

hex_gj <- hex |>
  sf::st_transform(3857) |>
  geojsonsf::sf_geojson() |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON(simplifyVector = FALSE)

axis_expansion_mult <- 0.5

```

```{r}
### set reentry 2030 project path
reentry_2030_cjars <- csg_get_project_path("reentry_2030_cjars")


### set path for exporting clean cjars data
reentry_2030_cjars_clean <- file.path(reentry_2030_cjars,
                                      "Data",
                                      "CJARS",
                                      "Clean")


#########################
### import files
#########################

#################
### state level
#################

### overall only
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only <- read_rds(file.path(reentry_2030_cjars_clean,"cjars_clean_state_overall_only.rds"))


### with disaggregations
df_cjars_q3_state_raw <- read_rds(file.path(reentry_2030_cjars_clean,"cjars_clean_state_with_breakdowns.rds"))


```


# Trends in Reentry 

**Note:** Throughout this analysis, I've used the earliest and latest year with available data -- this appears to differ depending on the state and metric. When possible, I've indicated the specific years used in the visual's tooltips. We may end up just wanting to include a single set of years (e.g. 2000 as earliest and 2021 as latest) to have consistency. 


I've used the 6 states listed on the reentry 2030 site (https://reentry2030.org/) as the group of reentry states throughout the analysis. Missouri and Alabama, though, appear to be missing from CJARS data so they're excluded from all analysis. 


<br>

## Recidivism

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Change over time 

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.5

df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_recidivism_map <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  ### filter out years/states with missing data
  filter(!is.na(inc_to_inc_recid_y2)) |> 
  group_by(state_name,
           state_abbr,
           fips) |> 
  ### now calculate % change over time from earliest year of data to latest year of data
  summarize(min_cohort_year = min(cohort_year),
            max_cohort_year = max(cohort_year),
            inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change = (inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == max_cohort_year] - inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == min_cohort_year]/inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == min_cohort_year])*100,
            inc_to_inc_recid_y2_min_year = inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == min_cohort_year],
            inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year = inc_to_inc_recid_y2[cohort_year == max_cohort_year]) |> 
  ungroup()

### add tooltip
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_recidivism_map_1 <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_recidivism_map |>
  ### add '+" in front of positive numbers and 0
  ### only for value we'll include in tooltip
  mutate(
    inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change_clean = as.numeric(comma(
      inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change, 1
    )),
    inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change_clean = sprintf("%+3d%%", inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change_clean),
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", state_name, "</b><br>",
      "Change in recidivism rate: ",
      inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change_clean,
      "<br>",
      "2-year recidivism rate in ",min_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_min_year, 1),
      "<br>",
      "2-year recidivism rate in ",max_cohort_year,": ",
      percent(inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year, 1)
    ))

# Get data range
data_range <-
  range(df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_recidivism_map_1$inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change,
        na.rm = TRUE)

min <- data_range[1]
max <- data_range[2]
# print(min); print(max)

# Adjust extremes so they are balanced at zero
new_min <- min(-abs(min), -abs(max))
new_max <- max(abs(min), abs(max))
# print(new_min); print(new_max)

### highchart
highchart() |>
  hc_add_series_map(
    map = hex_gj,
    df = df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_recidivism_map_1,
    joinBy = c("state_abb", "state_abbr"),
    value = "inc_to_inc_recid_y2_percent_change",
    nullColor = "#E8E8E8",
    dataLabels = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      format = "{point.state_abb}",
      style = list(
        fontSize = "13px",
        fontFamily = default_fonts,
        fontWeight = 700,
        textOutline = 0
      )
    ),
    accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "state: {point.state_name}, percent change: {point.value:.1f}"
        )
      )
  ) |>
  hc_title(
    text = "Change in recidivism over time",
    align = "left",
    style = list(
      fontFamily = header_font,
      color = "#005FAD",
      fontSize = "24px",
      fontWeight = "bold"
    )
  ) |>
  hc_subtitle(
    text = "Percent change in 2-year rates of reincarceration",
    align = "left",
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts, fontSize = "16px",
                                 color = "#666666")
  ) |> 
  hc_colorAxis(
    min = new_min,
    max = new_max,
    endOnTick = TRUE,
    startOnTick = TRUE,
    stops = color_stops(
      7,
      c(
        darkblue,
        regblue,
        lightblue,
        white,
        lightorange,
        orange,
        darkorange
      )
    ),
    labels = list(
      format = "{value}%",
      style = list(fontSize = "12px",
                  fontFamily = default_fonts)
    )
  ) |>
  hc_legend(
    align = "center",
    horizontalAlign = "bottom",
    layout = "horizontal",
    # title = list(text = "Percent Change"),
    symbolHeight = 25,
    symbolWidth = 250,
    x = 0,
    y = 0
  ) |>
  hc_tooltip(
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts),
    formatter = JS("function(){return(this.point.tooltip)}")
  )  |>
   hc_plotOptions(
      series = list(
        animation = FALSE,
        states = list(inactive = list(opacity = 1)),
        cursor = "pointer",
      accessibility = list(
          enabled = TRUE,
          keyboardNavigation = list(enabled = TRUE)),
      point = list(
          events = list(
            click = JS("function(){window.top.location.href = this.options.url}")))
      )
    ) |>  
  hc_caption(
    text = "Criminal Justice Administrative Records System (CJARS)",
    align = "right",
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts)
    ) |>
  hc_setup()

```

## Recidivism rates over time 

::: {.panel-tabset}


### 1-year reincarceration  

```{r }

to_plot <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  filter(!is.na(inc_to_inc_recid_y1)) |> 
  group_by(reentry_state_flag,
           cohort_year) |> 
  summarize(mean_rate = mean(inc_to_inc_recid_y1,
                             na.rm = TRUE)*100,
            mean_rate_label = mean(inc_to_inc_recid_y1,
                             na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ### arrange legend so that state name comes first followed by region name
  mutate(reentry_state_flag = fct_relevel(reentry_state_flag, 
                                          paste0("Non-Reentry 2030 States"), 
                                          after = Inf),
         ### create tooltip
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", reentry_state_flag, " – ", cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "Recidivism Rate (%): ", percent(mean_rate_label, 1)
      ))

rng <- range(to_plot$mean_rate)
mult <- diff(rng) * axis_expansion_mult

y_min <- rng[1] - mult
y_min <- if_else(y_min < 0, 0, y_min)
y_max <- rng[2] + mult
  

### now plot
to_plot |> 
  hchart(
    "spline",
    hcaes(cohort_year, mean_rate, group = reentry_state_flag),
    color = jr_pal[c(1, 7)],
    dashStyle = c("solid", "dash"),
    opacity = c(1, 0.75),
    accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "year: {point.x:.0f}, rate: {point.y:.1f}"
        )
      )      
  ) |> 
  hc_title(text = paste0("1-year reincarceration rates over time (averages)")) |>
  hc_caption(text = "Criminal Justice Administrative Records System (CJARS)") |>
  hc_yAxis(labels = list(format = "{value}%")) |>
  hc_setup()


```

### Poverty 

```{r}

df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_poverty_map <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  ### filter out years/states with missing data

           state_abbr,
           fips) |> 
  ### now calculate % change over time from earliest year of data to latest year of data
  summarize(min_cohort_year = min(cohort_year),
            max_cohort_year = max(cohort_year),
            inc_above_poverty_y3_min_year = inc_above_poverty_y3[cohort_year == min_cohort_year],
```

## Employment trends over time 

::: {.panel-tabset}


### Poverty   

```{r }

to_plot <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  filter(!is.na(inc_above_poverty_y3)) |> 
  group_by(reentry_state_flag,
           cohort_year) |> 
  summarize(mean_rate = mean(inc_above_poverty_y3,
                             na.rm = TRUE)*100,
            mean_rate_label = mean(inc_above_poverty_y3,
                             na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ### arrange legend so that state name comes first followed by region name
  mutate(reentry_state_flag = fct_relevel(reentry_state_flag, 
                                          paste0("Non-Reentry 2030 States"), 
                                          after = Inf),
         ### create tooltip
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", reentry_state_flag, " – ", cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "Poverty Rate (%): ", percent(mean_rate_label, 1)
      ))

rng <- range(to_plot$mean_rate)
mult <- diff(rng) * axis_expansion_mult

y_min <- rng[1] - mult
y_min <- if_else(y_min < 0, 0, y_min)
y_max <- rng[2] + mult
  

### now plot
to_plot |> 
  hchart(
    "spline",
    hcaes(cohort_year, mean_rate, group = reentry_state_flag),
    color = jr_pal[c(1, 7)],
    dashStyle = c("solid", "dash"),
    opacity = c(1, 0.75),
    accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "year: {point.x:.0f}, rate: {point.y:.1f}"
        )
      )      
  ) |> 
  hc_title(text = paste0("Poverty")) |>
  hc_subtitle(
    text = "Proportion of individuals above poverty, three years after release from prison (averages)",
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts, fontSize = "16px",
                                 color = "#666666")
  ) |> 
  hc_caption(text = "Criminal Justice Administrative Records System (CJARS)") |>
  hc_yAxis(labels = list(format = "{value}%")) |>
  hc_setup()


```

```{r }
mult <- diff(rng) * axis_expansion_mult

### now plot

  hchart(
    "spline",
```


### Mortality

```{r }

to_plot <- df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only |> 
  filter(!is.na(inc_mortality_y3)) |> 
  group_by(reentry_state_flag,
           cohort_year) |> 
  summarize(mean_rate = mean(inc_mortality_y3,
                             na.rm = TRUE)*100,
            mean_rate_label = mean(inc_mortality_y3,
                             na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  ### arrange legend so that state name comes first followed by region name
  mutate(reentry_state_flag = fct_relevel(reentry_state_flag, 
                                          paste0("Non-Reentry 2030 States"), 
                                          after = Inf),
         ### create tooltip
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", reentry_state_flag, " – ", cohort_year, "</b><br>",
      "Mortality rate (%): ", percent(mean_rate_label, 1)
      ))

rng <- range(to_plot$mean_rate)
mult <- diff(rng) * axis_expansion_mult

y_min <- rng[1] - mult
y_min <- if_else(y_min < 0, 0, y_min)
y_max <- rng[2] + mult
  

### now plot
to_plot |> 
  hchart(
    "spline",
    hcaes(cohort_year, mean_rate, group = reentry_state_flag),
    color = jr_pal[c(1, 7)],
    dashStyle = c("solid", "dash"),
    opacity = c(1, 0.75),
    accessibility = list(
      point = list(
        valueDescriptionFormat = "year: {point.x:.0f}, rate: {point.y:.1f}"
        )
      )      
  ) |> 
  hc_title(text = paste0("Mortality rate")) |>
  hc_subtitle(
    text = "Proportion of individuals who have passed away, three years after release from prison (averages)",
    style = list(fontFamily = default_fonts, fontSize = "16px",
                                 color = "#666666")
  ) |> 
  hc_caption(text = "Criminal Justice Administrative Records System (CJARS)") |>
  hc_setup() |> 
  hc_yAxis(labels = list(format = "{value}%")) 


```

## Reentry numbers by state

**Note:** Similar to the maps, I've pulled metrics from the latest year available -- this varies by state. 

```{r}
### combine dfs used for maps -- pulling metric from latest year available
### for each given metric (which we already did df by df above)

### first create list of all dfs to join via state name/fips
df_cjars_map_data_list <- list(df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_recidivism_map_2,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_poverty_map, 
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_w2_map,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_wages_map,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_housing_map,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_ssi_map,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_medicaid_map,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_medicare_map,
                                                     df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_mortality_map) 


### now merge all dfs -- keeping all states with at least one data point (via all = TRUE)
### select columns needed for table
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_to_table <- purrr::reduce(.x = df_cjars_map_data_list, 
                                                         merge, 
                                                         by = c("state_name",
                                                                "state_abbr",
                                                                "fips"), 
                                                         all = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::select(state_name,
                state_abbr,
                fips,
                inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map,
                inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_any_w2_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_w2_wages_y3_max_year,
                inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_ssi_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_medicaid_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_medicare_y3_max_year_to_map,
                inc_mortality_y3_max_year_to_map) |> 
  ### there are some pure duplicates based on differing min and max cohort years 
  ### this doesn't impact the current table/analysis/need
  distinct()


### create state-level table
df_cjars_q3_state_overall_only_to_table |> 
    select(state_name,
           inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map,
           inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_any_w2_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_w2_wages_y3_max_year,
           inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_ssi_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_medicaid_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_medicare_y3_max_year_to_map,
           inc_mortality_y3_max_year_to_map) |> 
  reactable_template(
    sort_col = list("state_name" = "asc"),
    columns = list(
      state_name = colDef(name = "State"),
      inc_to_inc_recid_y2_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "2-Year Recidivism Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_above_poverty_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "Poverty Rate (above poverty)",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_any_w2_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "W2 Filing Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_w2_wages_y3_max_year = colDef(name = "Income",
        format = colFormat(prefix = "$", digits = 0)), 
      inc_hud_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "HUD Assistance Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_ssi_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "SSI Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_medicaid_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "Medicaid Enrollment",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_medicare_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(name = "Medicare Enrollment",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)), 
      inc_mortality_y3_max_year_to_map = colDef(
        name = "Mortality Rate",
        format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 0)
        )
      )
    )

```
